newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.481 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.481 pct.

text.p: The average annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims fell to 1.481 percent from the previous issue's 1.625 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The issue, series 3.369, raised 831.85 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.627 percent. Pay date is January 16.
The previous issue, paid for on January 9, raised 831.5 million and was priced at 99.591 percent.
